title: Read an experiment before trusting it

choices.text: Control has 1,000,000 users and treatment 985,000. Before reading any metric, investigate the assignment and logging, because a split this uneven at this size is almost impossible by chance.
Treatment was significantly better on day 2, so the experiment could have been stopped then.
Click-through rate rose 3% in week one and 0.5% in week two; the long-run effect is probably closer to the second week's.
The primary metric improved, but p99 latency, a guardrail, rose from 180 ms to 260 ms; the launch needs a latency fix or an explicit trade-off decision first.
Offline NDCG rose 2%, so the online result does not matter.
